close_reason: Extracted 6 shared helpers (constants + mock_jmap_post + recorded_args/recorded_body + jmap_response + set_response + set_destroy_response + set_update_response) into crate-jmap-chat-client/tests/helpers.rs. Migrated all 42 smoke tests across chat_smoke_tests.rs, space_smoke_tests.rs, message_smoke_tests.rs. Net 395 lines removed (chat -216 / message -257 / space -118 / helpers +172). All 42 tests pass; workspace cargo test + clippy -D warnings clean. Deliberately preserved per-method-context state literals (m-state-2, mq-1, mc-old, qs-1, c-state-1, etc.) inline since they carry method-context meaning the canonical set-state pair doesn't.
description:
tests/chat_smoke_tests.rs, space_smoke_tests.rs, message_smoke_tests.rs. Specific duplicates:

1. `{"sessionState":"s1","methodResponses":[[...]]}` envelope hand-built ~26 times across 3 files.
2. `serde_json::from_slice(&reqs[0].body).expect(...)["methodCalls"][0][1]` repeated 19 times — trivially extracted to helpers::recorded_args(server).
3. Stock '/set destroy success' body duplicated near-verbatim at chat_smoke_tests.rs:573-591, space_smoke_tests.rs:131-149, message_smoke_tests.rs:637-655.
4. Stock '/set update success with updated: {id: null}' body duplicated 5 times. message_smoke_tests.rs already has message_set_update_resp() locally (line 709) but doesn't use it consistently and it lives in the wrong file.
5. "A13824" literal hardcoded ~26 times instead of a helpers::TEST_ACCOUNT_ID constant.
6. State literals ("s1", "r1", "c-old", "c-new", "sp-1", "ms-1", 20+ distinct names) where one disciplined before_state/after_state pair would suffice per file.

Push helpers into tests/helpers.rs. Volume reduction of ~30-40% per test file with no semantic change. Makes regressions easier to spot in the diff.
title: Smoke test boilerplate (request-envelope, args extraction) duplicated 26x
